text: Language models learn statistical regularities by predicting the next token in a sequence. A small model is useful for experiments because every stage can be inspected, repeated, and measured.

The scientific method starts with a question, continues with a falsifiable hypothesis, and uses observations to update confidence. Reproducibility requires preserving data provenance, code, configuration, and random seeds.

A transformer represents tokens as vectors. Self-attention lets each position combine information from earlier positions, while a causal mask prevents access to future tokens during autoregressive training.

Gradient descent changes parameters in the direction that reduces a loss function. Adam keeps moving averages of gradients and squared gradients, which improves optimization but consumes additional memory.
In astronomy, a light-year is a unit of distance rather than time. It is the distance light travels through vacuum in one Julian year, approximately 9.46 trillion kilometres.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy. Plants use carbon dioxide and water to produce carbohydrates, releasing oxygen as a consequence of the light-dependent reactions.
A prime number has exactly two positive divisors: one and itself. Euclid showed that there are infinitely many primes by considering a number formed from the product of known primes plus one.
La gravità è l'interazione che attrae i corpi dotati di massa ed energia. Sulla superficie terrestre l'accelerazione gravitazionale è circa 9,81 metri al secondo quadrato.
Un esperimento ben progettato distingue la correlazione dalla causalità. Randomizzazione, gruppi di controllo e analisi preregistrate riducono molte fonti di distorsione.
Il machine learning non trasforma automaticamente dati rumorosi in conoscenza. La qualità del campionamento, le etichette, le metriche e la validazione determinano ciò che un modello può imparare.
Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius under standard pressure, but the exact phase boundary changes with pressure. Scientific statements should name the conditions under which they hold.
A computer program is a precise sequence of instructions. Tests provide executable examples of expected behaviour and make refactoring safer when they cover meaningful boundaries and failure modes.
Entropy can describe the number of microscopic arrangements compatible with a macroscopic state. In information theory it also quantifies uncertainty in a probability distribution.
Neurons communicate through electrical and chemical signals. An action potential travels along an axon and can trigger neurotransmitter release at a synapse.
The derivative measures local rate of change. The integral accumulates infinitesimal contributions, and the fundamental theorem of calculus connects these two operations.
Una rete neurale generalizza quando mantiene buone prestazioni su esempi non usati per aggiornare i pesi. Memorizzare il training set non basta a dimostrare apprendimento utile.
Earth orbits the Sun on an ellipse with small eccentricity. Seasons are caused mainly by the tilt of Earth's rotational axis, not by large changes in distance from the Sun.
A database transaction is commonly described by atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability. These properties clarify what should happen when operations overlap or a system fails.
The speed of an algorithm is often expressed as a growth rate. Big-O notation suppresses constant factors to show how resource use changes as the input becomes larger.
Un modello linguistico genera distribuzioni di probabilità, non certificati di verità. Le risposte devono essere valutate con benchmark appropriati e controlli indipendenti.
Sound is a mechanical wave and needs a medium in which to propagate. In dry air near room temperature, its speed is roughly 343 metres per second.
The immune system combines rapid innate responses with adaptive responses that can develop specificity and memory. Its components interact rather than acting as a single central controller.
Version control records a graph of changes. A commit should describe one coherent state, and a branch provides a movable name for a line of development.
Nel ragionamento matematico, una risposta corretta non garantisce che ogni passaggio sia valido. Per questo è utile separare verifica del risultato e valutazione della spiegazione.
